reviewer: OpenCode actual visual comparison of each source, complete returned master, and white/cyan/alpha review sheet
alpha_note: Both masters have actual alpha extrema 0-253. The maximum 253 is not itself a rejection reason. White/cyan compositing shows a smoky translucent background instead of the source's light, substantially opaque photographic backplate.

reasons: The source's gray temple and side hair is absent even though the moustache and eyebrows are retained.
A visible white sclera crescent is added to one eye instead of preserving the reference's simple black eyes with green rings.
The light photographic backplate is changed to a dark, smoky, partially transparent background, as confirmed by white and cyan SourceOver compositing.
entries.positive_observation: The moustache, eyebrows, compact yellow mascot anatomy, cap, uniform and two non-duplicated collar patches are visibly retained.

reasons: Hair is present but changed from the source's visible brown to blond.
Visible white sclera is added around the black pupils instead of preserving the reference's simple black eyes with green rings.
The light photographic backplate is changed to a dark, smoky, partially transparent background, as confirmed by white and cyan SourceOver compositing.
entries.positive_observation: The yellow mascot identity, cap, side-facing composition, uniform and two non-duplicated collar patches are retained substantially better than in the earlier rejected experiments.
